title: NexusStrategyComposeResponse
description: Body of a committed compose operation (HTTP 200). `document` is the complete committed candidate at `new_revision`, resolved pins included, so the client replaces its candidate with this document instead of predicting server normalization.

new_revision.description: Revision the operation committed; always the request's `base_revision` plus one.

validation_summary.description: Committed validator diagnostics, even when empty. A diagnostic is reported, never defaulted away.

code.description: Diagnostic family: an unbound required slot, a slot binding flattening had to drop, a pin outside the operation's reach whose bytes changed, or a recorded pin whose package the registry no longer resolves.

nest_id.description: The nest that pins the package.

package_version.description: The pinned package version (present for `unbound_required_slot`, `stale_pin` and `pin_unavailable`).

slot.description: The slot name: unbound for `unbound_required_slot`, dropped for `slot_binding_dropped`.

message.description: Human-readable diagnostic safe for UI display.
